last.verdict: Solid beat, but unchanged guidance left shares flat after an early pop.

reasons.label: Guidance only reaffirmed
reasons.text: Home Depot beat estimates but kept its full-year outlook; the CFO cited a frozen housing market.

reasons.label: Beat helped by refunds
reasons.text: EPS of $4.92 topped $4.73 expected, aided by tariff refunds that offset higher fuel and input costs.

reasons.label: Small projects, weak traffic
reasons.text: Comparable sales rose 1.7%, but customer transactions fell 1.0% as big-project demand stayed soft.

story: Home Depot has kept guiding to little or no growth. Comparable sales were 0.4% last winter, 0.6% in spring and 1.7% now. Results have beaten estimates, but a stuck housing market and reaffirmed guidance keep the stock muted, down about 15% over 12 months.
